passages.text: Our class wants to take a trip to the hills during the school holiday. There are two paths from the bus stop, one steep and one more gentle. We decide to use the gentle path because some pupils are carrying heavy drawing equipment. The teacher gives everyone time to rest and check their bags before leaving. On the way, we stop beside a field and make quick drawings. The longer but easier route lets the whole group enjoy the visit together. We learn that choosing a route means thinking about everyone, not only the fastest walker.

parallelText.en: Our class wants to take a trip to the hills during the school holiday.
parallelText.zh: 我们班想在学校假期去山里旅行。

parallelText.en: There are two paths from the bus stop, one steep and one more gentle.
parallelText.zh: 从车站出发有两条路，一条陡，一条更缓。

parallelText.en: We decide to use the gentle path because some pupils are carrying heavy drawing equipment.
parallelText.zh: 我们决定走缓路，因为有些同学带着较重的绘画器材。

parallelText.en: The teacher gives everyone time to rest and check their bags before leaving.
parallelText.zh: 出发前，老师让每个人休息、检查包。

parallelText.en: On the way, we stop beside a field and make quick drawings.
parallelText.zh: 途中，我们在田边停下，画速写。

parallelText.en: The longer but easier route lets the whole group enjoy the visit together.
parallelText.zh: 这条更长但更容易的路线让全组一起享受游览。

parallelText.en: We learn that choosing a route means thinking about everyone, not only the fastest walker.
parallelText.zh: 我们学会了，选路线要考虑每个人，而不仅是走得最快的人。

passages.text: Our radio club needs a quiet place to record an interview. At first, we choose a seat beside the main road in the town. The sound of buses is the reason we cannot hear the speaker clearly. Mia suggests a quieter part of the town near a small garden. We try recording one question there and listen to it before beginning again. The new recording is easier to understand, so we continue in the garden. A short test helps us choose a better place before spending time on the whole interview.

parallelText.en: Our radio club needs a quiet place to record an interview.
parallelText.zh: 我们的广播社团需要安静的地方录采访。

parallelText.en: At first, we choose a seat beside the main road in the town.
parallelText.zh: 起初，我们选了镇上主路边的座位。

parallelText.en: The sound of buses is the reason we cannot hear the speaker clearly.
parallelText.zh: 公交车的声音是我们听不清说话人的原因。

parallelText.en: Mia suggests a quieter part of the town near a small garden.
parallelText.zh: 米娅建议换到镇上靠近小花园的一片更安静区域。

parallelText.en: We try recording one question there and listen to it before beginning again.
parallelText.zh: 我们在那里试录一个问题，听完后再重新开始。

parallelText.en: The new recording is easier to understand, so we continue in the garden.
parallelText.zh: 新录音更容易听懂，于是我们在花园继续。

parallelText.en: A short test helps us choose a better place before spending time on the whole interview.
parallelText.zh: 简短测试帮助我们先选好地点，再花时间录完整采访。
